reason: The private AtprotoTransient scheme authenticates exact request bytes and claims durable replay before dispatch. ExpectedTenantId binds the recovered target, never ambient tenant authority; the handler checks an enabled tenant and P1 conditionally deletes only the exact row identity, purpose, digest and tenant. AtprotoTransientStoreControllerTests proves mismatches and concurrent losers reveal no payload.
removalTrigger: Remove when the private transient capability is retired or its target moves to authenticated transport metadata; never replace this binding with a fabricated user or tenant-filter bypass.

reason: The dedicated exact-body machine assertion authenticates the expected lookup target. reason: CustomPropertyProjectionAdminController explicitly body-binds a tenant-wide drain target; CustomPropertyProjectionAuthorizationFacts uses that exact tenant and projection scope as the server-side authorization boundary before the handler validates both fields and drains only that tenant's dirty scopes.

reason: This field explicitly selects the moderator who will receive the route-selected report case; ModerateLight authorization gates the persisted event, while the handler derives the acting moderator from ICurrentUserService and verifies the target assignee is an active user in ITenantContext before mutation.

removalTrigger: Remove this disposition if an authoritative route or server workflow selects the support target; otherwise retain explicit target authorization, tenant existence validation, and actor-preserving audit evidence.
